definitions.dry: Measured 0.00 in with no trace. Missing data never counts as dry.
definitions.trace: Precipitation observed but too small to measure (under 0.005 in).
definitions.same_day: Rain on the reservation date itself (known only after the fact).
definitions.prev1: Rain on the previous calendar day.
definitions.trail2: Total over the 2 days before the date (excludes the date itself).
definitions.trail3: Total over the 3 days before the date (excludes the date itself).
definitions.during: Hourly observation ending at :51 of the slot's start hour (covers the prior :51 to :51).
definitions.prevNh: Sum of the N hourly observations ending before the slot starts; any missing hour makes it missing.

sources.units_in_file: hundredths of an inch (METAR P group)

reconciliation.basis: hourly sums regrouped to Local Standard Time days to match LCD
